epic_parcool_momentum.parcool.dodge_noti: Dodge (Disabled by default and can be enabled manually. To prevent conflicts, do not bind Step and Dodge to the same key.)
Enter accelerated perception for 10 seconds. Nearby entities slow down while you gain movement speed and chromatic afterimages. Attacking ends the effect.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.sand: Applies a radial speed blur around the world view while Sandevistan is active. HUD elements, text, and the first-person hand remain sharp. Disabling this option stops the post-processing shader from running.
Controls the overall amount of edge blur. 0.0 makes it invisible and 1.0 uses the full effect. Adjust this when you want weaker blur without changing the area covered by it.

Controls how far each sample moves toward the screen center, which determines the length of the speed-blur trails. The current default is 0.30. Values from 0.05–0.10 are moderate, 0.15–0.30 create a strong high-speed effect, 0.30–0.45 approach Awaken's grappling-hook impact, and 0.45–0.60 are extreme and may visibly stretch the screen edges.
Controls how many additional texture reads are used for each pixel. The current default is 10. Higher values look smoother but require more GPU work; lower-end GPUs can reduce this to 4–6.
Controls where blur begins. The current default is 0.60. 0 represents the screen center and 1 represents the border; higher values restrict blur to a thinner outer edge.

Controls where blur reaches full strength. The current default is 0.80. 0 represents the screen center and 1 represents the border. This should normally be greater than Edge Blur Start Position; lower values reach full strength sooner.

Applies a radial screen-edge stretch when Sandevistan activates, then automatically fades it into the normal sustained edge blur. This reuses the existing post-processing pass and does not affect the time-dilation simulation.

Controls the maximum outward stretch of the screen edges during activation. The current default is 0.20, producing a clearly visible camera impact. Values from 0.05–0.12 are gentler, 0.12–0.22 approach the strong stretch in the reference video, and higher values may excessively magnify the edges.

Controls the total time from the beginning of one activation distortion pulse until it fully disappears. The default is 12 ticks, or about 0.6 seconds. This does not change the duration of the Sandevistan skill itself.

Controls how many ticks the activation distortion takes to rise from zero to full strength. The current default is 5 ticks, allowing the stretch to build over a short interval. Setting this to 0 reaches the peak immediately; the effective rise time is limited by the total duration.
Controls where the activation distortion begins. The default is 0.45. 0 represents the screen center and 1 represents the border; higher values preserve a larger undistorted center area.

Controls where the activation distortion reaches full strength. The current default is 0.60. This should normally be greater than Activation Distortion Start Position; lower values reach maximum stretch sooner.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.cust: true: enables this mod's custom FastRun animation replacement and related step/jump visuals. false: keeps EpicParCool's default FastRun animation behavior and disables the R-key FastRun step.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.auto: true: when WOM is not installed and no datapack FastRun rule matches the current weapon, automatically generates FastRun from the weapon's Epic Fight RUN animation. false: unmatched no-WOM weapons use EpicParCool's default FastRun animation. If the weapon RUN animation cannot be resolved, this option falls back to EpicParCool's default FastRun animation.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.natu: true: pressing the configured FastRun Step key can trigger a step during EpicParCool FastRun. When WOM Natural Sprinter is available, its step resource is consumed. Otherwise this mod uses a generic cooldown. This only works when customFastRunAnimations is also true.

Controls how FastRun Step and ParCool Dodge share one key. When ParCool Dodge is disabled in ParCool settings, this option is ignored and the shared key behaves as FastRun Step. disabled: do not arbitrate. Step and Dodge keep their normal behavior. short_dodge_long_step: short press triggers Dodge; holding then releasing triggers Step. This is the default. short_step_hold_dodge: short press triggers Step; holding triggers Dodge. Releasing after Dodge has fully ended can trigger Step. single_step_double_dodge: single tap triggers Step after the double-tap window; double tap triggers Dodge.
Ticks held before a shared Step/Dodge key counts as a long press. 6 ticks is about 300 ms at 20 TPS.
Maximum ticks between first release and second press for single_step_double_dodge. Single-tap Step is delayed by this window. Default 2 matches ParCool's native movement-key double-tap window.
Maximum held ticks for the first tap to be eligible for double-tap Dodge.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.fast: true: allows one startup step when entering FastRun. false: entering FastRun never plays a startup step.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.auto: true: when FastRun is entered by a non-manual path, it can still auto-trigger one startup step. false: non-manual FastRun entry does not auto-trigger a startup step; only the manual FastRun key path can do it.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.move: Player speed, relative to vanilla sprint, required for Epic Fight MovementAnimation to reach the extended maximum playback speed. 1.6 means the animation reaches its maximum at 160% of vanilla sprint speed.
Maximum playback multiplier for player Epic Fight MovementAnimation above vanilla sprint speed. The default 1.856 is 1.16 multiplied by 1.6.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.catL: true: pressing jump after CatLeap can trigger Epic Fight Phantom Ascent.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.wall: true: pressing jump after ParCool WallJump can trigger Epic Fight Phantom Ascent.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.clim: true: pressing jump after ParCool ClimbUp can trigger Epic Fight Phantom Ascent before glider deployment.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.spid: true: pressing jump after Spider Techniques wall jump can trigger Epic Fight Phantom Ascent.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.repl: true: replaces Epic Fight Phantom Ascent jump, fall, and landing animations with this mod's double-jump animation set. false: keeps Epic Fight's original Phantom Ascent jump, fall, and landing animation behavior.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.disa: true: blocks Epic Fight Phantom Ascent while the player is swimming underwater. false: keeps Epic Fight's original Phantom Ascent behavior underwater.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.phan: Maximum fall damage canceled by Phantom Ascent's next-fall protection. Epic Fight original default is 2.5.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.demo: true: after learning Epic Fight Demolition Leap, Shift+Jump starts Demolition Leap through Epic Fight's original hold/release chain and suppresses ParCool Cat Leap/Charge Jump on that input. false: keeps Epic Fight Demolition Leap and ParCool Cat Leap/Charge Jump trigger paths separate.
true: after Demolition Leap launches the player, the next new airborne jump press triggers Epic Fight Phantom Ascent through its native chain.

true: before learning Demolition Leap, ParCool Charge Jump charging uses Demolition Leap's charging animation in Epic Fight mode. After learning Demolition Leap, Shift alone shows no charging animation - only Shift+Space triggers the skill.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.auto: true: automatically restores sprint shortly after ParCool WallJump.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.wall: true: ParCool WallJump opens a short window for Epic Fight air attacks.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.tacz: true: TaCZ guns can cancel ParCool WallJump and fire immediately.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.wall: Maximum fall damage canceled after a ParCool WallJump air-attack window. Matches Phantom Ascent's default value.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.disa: true: disables ParCool VerticalWallRun after learning WOM Spider Techniques.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.spid: Wall-run mode used after learning WOM Spider Techniques. default: Default wall-run mode. This mod does not replace ParCool/WOM wall-run triggers, but keeps original WOM side wall-run direction and corner-transfer fixes. parcool: ParCool wall-run mode. ParCool's HorizontalWallRun key triggers this mod's WOM-style wall run replacement. wom: WOM wall-run mode. WOM's original sprint input owns Spider Techniques wall run, while ParCool HorizontalWallRun and its key input are disabled. Modes that need WOM do nothing when WOM is not installed or Spider Techniques is not learned.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.parC: Animation transition time used when ParCool wall-run mode switches WOM Spider Techniques wall-run animations. Higher values feel heavier but make direction changes slower.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.spid: Maximum horizontal look angle, in degrees, for WOM Spider Techniques wall jump to keep priority over ParCool WallJump. 0 means the player must look straight into the wall. 90 means WOM keeps priority from any side-facing angle. Default 50 lets direct wall-facing input use WOM, while side-facing wall-run input prefers ParCool WallJump.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.aqua: true: without Aqua Maneuvre, maps ParCool FastSwimAnimator to WOM's Mermaid animation in Epic Fight mode. After learning Aqua Maneuvre, ParCool's FastRun control mode only drives WOM's original Mermaid fast-swim input; WOM owns movement, speed, animation start, and animation exit.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.epic: true: after learning EpicFightX Combat Mastery II, post-dodge sprint follows this mod's Combat Mastery sprint trigger mode. false: keeps EpicFightX's original Combat Mastery II sprint trigger behavior.

Controls how this mod enters vanilla sprint after an EpicFightX Combat Mastery II dodge window. Toggle: press the FastRun key again after the dodge, then hold forward to enter vanilla sprint. Auto: automatically enters vanilla sprint after the dodge when forward input is held. PressKey: hold the FastRun key and forward input to enter and keep vanilla sprint.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.fast: true: when Vault starts from FastRun, releases ParCool's Vault action at 6 ticks and keeps a short FastRun grace window so close obstacles can chain through ParCool's original Vault detection. false: keeps ParCool's original Vault action timing and disables this mod's FastRun Vault chaining assist.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.vaul: true: lets Vault accept a short recent-FastRun window when FastRun drops immediately before ParCool Vault can start. false: Vault start requires ParCool FastRun to still be actively doing, except for the existing post-Vault chain grace.

Changes ParCool Vault's maximum detected obstacle height. ParCool original default is 0.86. This compatibility mod defaults to 1.5 for stable three-block air vaults. Lower values require more precise jump timing.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.epic: Vertical velocity applied when EpicFight mode starts ParCool ClimbUp. ParCool original value is 0.6. This defaults to 0.65 to better match EpicFightParCool's climb-up animation with re-grabbing full blocks.
Per-tick left/right air-control velocity applied during EpicParCool ClimbUp. Set to 0.0 to disable. This only affects left/right input and is intended to mimic ParCool's vanilla air movement.
How many ticks after EpicParCool ClimbUp starts left/right air-control compensation can be applied. Set to 0 to disable.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.sand: Local tick-rate multiplier for entities near the Sandevistan user.
Radius in blocks affected by time dilation.
Additional movement-speed multiplier applied to the Sandevistan user.
Ticks between textured Sandevistan afterimages while moving.
Maximum number of Sandevistan afterimages retained for the local player.
Maximum number of Sandevistan afterimages retained for each remote player.
Lifetime in ticks of each Sandevistan afterimage.
Minimum movement distance in blocks before another afterimage can be captured.
Initial opacity of textured Sandevistan afterimages.
Enables the low-cost green Sandevistan screen filter.
Strength of the green Sandevistan screen filter.
Ticks used to fade in the Sandevistan screen filter.
Ticks used to fade out the Sandevistan screen filter.

epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.sand: Separates the red and blue channels radially during the Sandevistan activation pulse, recreating the high-speed impact seen in the reference video. It only runs during the distortion pulse; disabling it saves two texture reads.

Controls the maximum sampling offset between the red and blue channels. The default is 0.012, keeping the center stable while producing visible edge fringing. Excessive values create strong colored ghosting.
Produces a short full-screen white exposure flash when the Sandevistan activation distortion reaches its peak, then rapidly fades instead of remaining for the skill duration.
Controls the maximum amount of white exposure mixed into the screen. The default is 0.72 for a strong reference-like flash; lower values preserve more scene detail, while 1.0 approaches pure white.
epic_parcool_momentum.configuration.debu: Debug Sandevistan Frame Hitches

Disabled by default. When enabled, logs only frames exceeding the configured threshold, including rendered afterimage count, afterimage CPU time, post-process time, green-filter time, and current sampling settings. Output is limited to once every 0.5 seconds; disable it after testing.
Sandevistan Hitch Log Threshold (ms)

Frame time in milliseconds required to emit a Sandevistan performance diagnostic entry. The default is 33 ms, roughly below 30 FPS. Lower values capture smaller fluctuations; higher values record only severe hitches.
